The syntax id is deliberately on 'what was wrong' rather than 'event order (fixed)': the syntax dimension requires semantic <code> in its fragment and the event-order table uses <strong> not <code>, while 'what was wrong' carries the participating <code> tokens (click, document.getSelection(), input.selectionStart, input.selectionEnd) whose observed behavior the change alters.
